entries.claim: AC-browser: physician-sample Chromium browser qualification suite (--test site -- --ignored --test-threads=1) against disposable Postgres
AC-infra: tofu fmt -check, offline tofu test (rust-environments, public-site, observability), and rust-environments Python contract tests
command: set -euo pipefail; tofu fmt -check -recursive infra/gcp; for d in infra/gcp/rust-environments infra/gcp/public-site infra/gcp/observability; do (cd "$d" && tofu init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly >/dev/null && tofu test); done; python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/gcp/rust-environments/tests -p "*.py" -v

entries.claim: AC-workflows-docs: actionlint on workflows and check-book-links.sh across mdBook documentation
AC-rust: cargo fmt --check, gmail tests, public-site tests, and workspace Clippy -D warnings
command: set -euo pipefail; cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --locked -j 4 -p gmail && cargo test --locked -j 4 -p public-site --lib --tests && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
